lines.t: For I am The Lord, He who stretched out the heavens and hung the earth upon nothing.

I am He who created all these worlds, He who causes all things to be. I am He who formed man from the dust of the earth and gave him breath, and he became a living soul. Behold, I spoke all life into existence, yes, I am He who called all things into existence, saying, “Arise and declare My glory!” For all creation obeys the sound of My voice.
Yea, the whole universe declares My glory, for I am He who commanded the stars to shine their light and the galaxies to take their form.
Behold, My voice reaches across the universe, and reverence is spread out before Me. For I command the hills to bow down and the mountains to be brought low, and it is so.
Yea, the whole earth trembles when I pass by, for I am great in power and My glory has no equal! Thus the fear of The Lord goes before Me, and obedience follows after Me, says The Lord.
